name: How does AKN Design Group ensure the craftsmanship of a large custom deck?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure the craftsmanship of a large custom deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures the craftsmanship of a large custom deck through our integrated design-build process and unwavering commitment to quality. Our team oversees every phase, from detailed design and material selection to skilled construction and final inspections. With over two decades of experience and more than 10,000 jobs completed, our proven track record speaks to our dedication. This first-party insight highlights our philosophy of honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship, ensuring that each deck is built to exacting standards, resulting in lasting impressions and enhanced home value.
